plan.major: Graphic Arts and Media Technology (Graphic Design)
plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Graphic Design, Graphic Arts and Media Technology, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/graphic-arts-and-media-technology-graphic-design-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Graphic Arts and Media Technology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: footnote 5 = 'See General Education requirements for AA/AS'; footnote 6 = 'See program recommendations and requirements'. Those slots are modeled as choice slots carrying those definitions; see advisor. Blank unnamed rows in the 3rd/4th-semester grids are modeled as generic elective slots (see advisor). Designed to transfer to the BFA in Graphic Arts at UNR and the BA in Visual Media at NSU. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
